name: dry-run
description: Claude explains its design before it touches your code. A gate blocks code edits until you say go.

explainLanguage.title: Explain language
explainLanguage.description: Language you read well (for example java). Claude then explains code in other languages with it. Use off to switch this off.

practiceRepoPath.title: Practice repo path
practiceRepoPath.description: Folder of your DSA practice repo. Leave empty to switch the practice feed off.

examplePack.title: Example pack
examplePack.description: Which example pack the rules tool returns.

coach.title: Design Coach
coach.description: Review each dry run with a second model. Advice only.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play short sounds when the gate opens, an edit is blocked or the coach finishes. macOS only.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: How the Design Card looks: card (boxes), rail (a timeline) or buddy (Clawd says it). In a session, /dry-run layout <name> changes it.
